items.title: independent check of the zeta reader before it judges any G3 run
items.task: Independent check of the zeta reader before it judges any G3 run (coord/DECISIONS/0041 item 1). You did not write it. About seventy-five minutes, processors only. Artefacts: the 32-cell mirrored pairs of run E-20261125-153148-cfad424 (outputs under scratch/E-stoch-inf/<run id>/); the deck and its potential (scope/SCOPE.md section 4d.3: the inflection model in code units); the definitions of scope sections 4d.1 and 4d.9 (zeta as delta N to the uniform-field surface; tests Z0 to Z2 as written, with Z2(iii) and (iii')). Do NOT read zeta/zeta_reader.py or the lead's journal entries on these tests before your own numbers exist. (1) Write a reader of your own: your own parser of the dumps, your own homogeneous background integrator for N(phi, Pi) to the end surface, your own second-order expansion. Test it first on a case with a closed form (a slow-roll potential whose delta N is known). A prediction before each computation, the outcome after it. (2) For the pairs compute: the linear relation of zeta to R^NR (sign and coefficient); the quadratic coefficient of zeta at both amplitudes; the coefficients of the map along the field alone, along the momentum alone, and along the box's own relation between the field and momentum perturbations. (3) The lead's reader fails its test Z1 along the momentum alone (second coefficient off by 0.142 against a bar of one per cent) and passes along the field and along the box's relation. Find with your reader whether that is a defect of a reader, a wrong expected value of the test, or a property of the map near the inflection (for example the map is not analytic in the momentum at fixed field through the ultra-slow-roll phase, or the end surface is reached differently). State how far the box's states lie from its own relation, and what error in the one-point statistics at three and four sigma a reader with that discrepancy would make. (4) Only then compare with zeta/zeta_reader.py and the lead's numbers: per quantity, agreement to how many digits, or not. Deliver g3/zeta_verify/VERIFY.md with figures you looked at and a verdict line: the reader may judge G3 runs as it is / after these changes / not.
